changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionPredicate')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionPredicate]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Type] [nvarchar](255) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](100) NOT NULL, [Inverse] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionPredicate] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedPredicate')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedPredicate]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionDeletedPredicate] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionPredicate')) BEGIN DROP TABLE [api].[ExecutionPredicate] END
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedPredicate')) BEGIN DROP TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedPredicate] END
